jobs.title: Financial Analyst (FPA) - Ecommerce
jobs.description:
**Role Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced **FP\&A Analyst** to lead financial planning and analysis, with strong expertise in **budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and feasibility studies**, supporting strategic decision\-making across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)**

* Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long\-range planning processes.
* Develop and maintain robust financial models to support business planning and strategic initiatives.
* Analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting variances and key drivers.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management based on financial data analysis.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, and presentations for leadership and board reviews.

**Feasibility Studies \& Strategic Analysis**

* Conduct long\-term feasibility studies for new projects, business expansions, capital investments, and product lines.
* Perform cost\-benefit analysis, ROI, NPV, IRR, and payback period calculations to evaluate investment opportunities.
* Assess financial risks and opportunities associated with new business initiatives.
* Support due diligence processes for mergers, acquisitions, or partnerships, as required.

**Financial Management**

* Oversee cash flow planning, working capital management, and capital expenditure planning.
* Lead negotiations with banks and financial institutions for credit facilities, working capital lines, term loans, and other banking arrangements on favorable terms.
* Maintain and manage relationships with banking partners, ensuring timely renewal, renegotiation, and compliance of facility terms and covenants.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data used for planning and reporting purposes.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams (Sales, Operations, Procurement, Inventory, etc.) to align financial plans with business objectives.
* Monitor industry trends, market conditions, and economic factors that may impact business performance.

**Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure financial planning processes comply with internal policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Support internal and external audits with relevant financial planning documentation and analysis.
* Maintain strong internal controls over financial planning and reporting processes.
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
* Collaborate with senior leadership to translate business strategy into financial plans.
* Present financial insights and recommendations clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior finance team members, as applicable.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent knowledge of Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), including budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Strong expertise in financial modeling and long\-term feasibility studies.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling tools; hands\-on experience with Odoo ERP and BI/dashboarding tools (Power BI, Tableau) is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience in negotiating banking facilities, credit lines, and loan terms with financial institutions.
* Proficient in building and maintaining financial dashboards for real\-time performance tracking and reporting.
* Tech\-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn and leverage new financial systems, automation tools, and data analytics platforms.
* High level of integrity and professional ethics.

**Qualifications**

* MBA in Finance / CA / ACCA or equivalent professional certification holders only.
* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in financial planning \& analysis and corporate finance.
* Proven track record of conducting feasibility studies and supporting strategic investment decisions.

Pay: AED10,000\.00 \- AED12,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview \& Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

**PURPOSE OF THE JOB**

The principal activities are collecting, developing, analyzing, coordinating, directing, recommending, and presenting the results of the analyses to financial management, operations management and senior executives.


**SPECIFIC JOB RESPONSIBILITES/COMPETENCIES**

* Accurate, consistent and timely reporting of financial data in accordance with regional and corporate schedules
* Process ownership of Business Unit monthly outlooks, quarterly forecast and annual plan, including preparation and consolidation of financial information
* Develop and maintain financial models for monthly outlooks, quarterly forecasts and annual plans
* Complete informed variance analysis of actual results and forecast projections vs defined comparators
* Inform and advise Commercial Financial Manager of all significant financial matters as they arise
* Analyze to understand actual expenses and forecasts, trends and have input into any spend management actions required
* Report information so that action may be taken to enhance operating results
* Calculation of annual absorption \& burden rates
* Assist in the preparation of Capital plans and forecasts
* Administration of capital spend requests
* Preparation of the financial models to support capital expenditure
* Oversee capital spending reviews to review financial performance compared to assumptions included in the justification
* Other analysis as required on an adhoc basis

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE**

* Professional accounting qualification (CIMA, ACCA or equivalent)
* Experience of management accounting practices
* Must be able to demonstrate strong forecasting and planning skills covering the full P\&L
* Strong analytical skills and excel knowledge
* The ability to work to strict deadlines with minimal supervision
* Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
* The ability to explain complex financial information in a clear way
* Previous experience with percentage of completion revenue recognition and absorption costing are preferred
* 4 \- 6 years of relevant working experience in a multinational work environment.

**Base Location \& Work Schedule**

This is a full time permanent position based in KEZAD Free Zone in Abu Dhabi. Hybrid work schedule \- 3 days office, 2 days WFH (Monday \- Friday).

jobs.title: Financial Analyst – Budgeting & Reporting
jobs.description:
##### **Job Summary:**


The American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK) is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Financial Analyst – Budgeting \& Reporting to join its Office of Finance.


This role will support financial reporting, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, while helping strengthen the University’s financial systems, reporting tools, and data\-driven decision\-making.


##### **Job Description:**


**Financial Analyst – Budgeting \& Reporting**


**Office of Finance**


**American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK), UAE**


**General Information About Institution**


The American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK) is an independent co\-education institution of Higher Education that provides an integrated American\-style, undergraduate and graduate education. All programs are accredited by the Ministry of Education of the UAE; additionally, it is accredited by the U.S. regional accreditation association, the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC). The American model of higher education ensures not only skills in specific academic fields, but also a general education curriculum that exposes students to new ideas and ways of thinking critically about local and global issues. AURAK is a young and rapidly growing university. AURAK is located in Ras Al Khaimah, one of the Northern Emirates and a rapidly growing region. The beauty of Ras Al Khaimah is reflected in its traditions and diverse landscapes — its white sandy beaches, the majestic Hajjar Mountains, the expansive desert and its sands dunes, and the many historical sites.


AURAK values diversity, inclusiveness and cultural authenticity where all individuals are treated based on their merits and abilities. AURAK is proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourages applications from all qualified applicants irrespective of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, or age.


**About the Role**


The American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK) is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Financial Analyst – Budgeting \& Reporting to join its Office of Finance.


This role will support financial reporting, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, while helping strengthen the University’s financial systems, reporting tools, and data\-driven decision\-making.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Support accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis activities.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness and timely availability of financial information for management and decision\-making.
* Support the effective implementation, adoption and ongoing enhancement of ERP\-enabled finance processes, including Oracle and Banner.
* Contribute to process improvements, system controls, workflow enhancements and standardization of Finance processes within the ERP environment.
* Develop, maintain and utilize financial dashboards, reports and analytical tools to support management reporting and performance monitoring.
* Monitor financial data and transactions across relevant systems, identify discrepancies or trends, and coordinate timely resolution.
* Support budgetary controls, expenditure monitoring, forecasting and analysis against approved plans.
* Provide Finance\-related support for system changes, testing, reporting requirements, data validation and user requirements.


**Key Result Areas and Duties**


KRA 1: Accounting and Financial Reporting (60%)  

KRA 2: Budgeting and Planning (40%)


**Academic and Professional Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CPA, or CMA.


**Work Experience**


Essential: Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial reporting, and budgeting within a large organization.


**Skills and Knowledge**


* Strong accounting and financial analysis skills.
* Budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to identify financial trends, discrepancies, and variances.
* Strong reporting and data interpretation skills.
* Proficiency in working with financial systems and ERP environments.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time management and organizational abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across different departments.
* High standards of professional ethics and integrity.
* Commitment to service excellence and achieving results.


**Language Proficiency Required**


Advanced proficiency in speaking, reading and writing English.


**Working Relationships**


AURAK Staff  

External Auditors  

Tax/VAT authorities and other relevant external parties


**Key Behaviors**


Service Excellence  

Professional Ethics and Integrity  

Problem\-solving  

Time Management  

Teamwork
